description: Extract product/listing cards from category, collection, marketplace, or search-result pages.

normalization_rules.url_fields: Convert relative URLs to absolute URLs.
normalization_rules.price_fields: Preserve raw price text and add numeric value when parseable. Do not hallucinate missing prices.
normalization_rules.currency: Use visible currency symbol/code; otherwise infer from verified regional site and mark inferred=true in provenance.
normalization_rules.rating: Normalize to 0-5 scale when possible and preserve raw text.
normalization_rules.duplicates: Deduplicate primarily by product_url; fallback to product_name + price_raw + image_url.
